messages:
nina: Heads-up: launching NovaEdge early access next week. Need checklist for NDA handoff + minimal benchmark suite. Key asks: perf (tokens/s), p99 latency, power stability.

ram: Baseline model locked: redwood/llama-lite-v2 int8. Dataset: preview-mini-5k. Throughput measured in tokens/s.

elaine: Ops: we have one NovaEdge node ready in rack-7. ops-bot, reserve Tue 09:00-16:00 and attach ssh key.

ops-bot: reservation confirmed: rack-7 slot reserved 2026-04-07 09:00-16:00 (owner: elaine).

ram: Acceptance: throughput >= 1000 tokens/s, p99 <= 60ms, QoR delta <= 0.7% embedding cosine >= 0.975. No OOMs in 4k sequence soak.

nina: Telemetry: capture nvml, kernel selection, and runtime env. Upload target s3://redwood-preview/novaedge/1777777777/.

elaine: I'll run bench and post results.json to the doc. Plan: run Tue, sync Wed 11:00 PT for signoff.

ram: Adding small public-facing one-slide summary if we pass.

nina: Thanks all ":thumbsup:", tag me on blockers.
